collection.description: A dying villager wishes to leave the healing hut and spend their remaining time beneath the trees they planted.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A dying villager wishes to leave the healing hut and spend their remaining time beneath the trees they planted.

choices.label: Encourage continued treatment at the healing hut.
Offer a compromise with visits from healers.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient dies surrounded by familiar sights and loved ones.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient lives several more weeks, enjoying visits and stories.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient agrees to a short trial but asks to return home if it fails.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient refuses and asks the healers to respect their choice.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient returns home and receives help when symptoms worsen.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A healer learns that comfort and treatment need not always be opposites.
